question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

One must aim to develop __intrinsic__ motivation within learners for better retention of knowledge.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Extrinsic.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Intrinsic
 being an extremely important and basic characteristic of a person or thing. (आंतरिक)
 
 

 Extrinsic
 not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside. (बाहरी; अनावश्यक; बाह्य)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• ​​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Elemental
 related to or constituting the basic or essential parts of something. (मौलिक)
 
 

 Introjected
 internalizing beliefs, attitudes, or values from others without considering their validity or appropriateness. (अंतर्मुखी)
 
 

 Inherent
 something that is an essential part of something else, intrinsic, or natural. (अंतर्निहित)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Intrinsic' and 'Extrinsic' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.
